rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to a web page allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: Using user-controlled data to create a template can lead to remote code execution or cross site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
rules.description: Deserializing user-controlled data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Using jinja2 templates with 'autoescape=False' can cause a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
rules.description: Building a NoSQL query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious NoSQL code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Cookies with `SameSite` set to `None` can allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Observable Timing Discrepancy
rules.description: When checking a Hash over a message, a constant-time algorithm should be used. Otherwise, an attacker may be able to forge a valid Hash for an arbitrary message by running a timing attack if they can send to the validation procedure. A successful attack can result in authentication bypass.

rules.cwe_name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
rules.description: Disabling or weakening CSRF protection may make the application vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attack.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

rules.cwe_name: Direct Request ('Forced Browsing')
rules.description: A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')
rules.description: Building a XPath query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious Xpath code by the user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs
rules.description: Building log entries from user-controlled data is vulnerable to insertion of forged log entries by a malicious user.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
rules.description: From user-controlled data saved in CSV files, it is easy to attempt information disclosure or other malicious activities when automated by spreadsheet software

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
rules.description: Building an LDAP query from user-controlled sources is vulnerable to insertion of malicious LDAP code by the user.
